# FatFs

[FatFs](http://elm-chan.org/fsw/ff/) R0.16 by ChaN, from `ff16.zip`. `ff.c`, `ff.h`, `ffunicode.c`, `diskio.h` and `00readme.txt` are unmodified, except that their line endings are LF. `ffconf.h` sets these options: `FF_USE_FASTSEEK 1`, `FF_CODE_PAGE 437`, `FF_USE_LFN 1`, `FF_LFN_UNICODE 2` (UTF-8), `FF_FS_NORTC 1`, `FF_NORTC_YEAR 2026`.

The license is in the header of each source file.
